title: USGS groundwater levels (depth to water)
fetched: 3,425 depth-to-water measurements at 310 wells within 0.12 degrees of the pilot box; 18 wells have 8+ years since 1990
resolution: Point measurements at wells; typically one or two visits a year
credit: U.S. Geological Survey, National Water Information System (USGS Water Data for the Nation). Public domain.
message: 310 wells, 3,425 measurements; of 18 wells with long records, 12 show the water table getting deeper since 1990; sanity passed
notes: Depth below land surface: a larger number means a deeper water table. Readings flagged as taken during or just after pumping are excluded from trends. A well a few kilometres from a field describes the aquifer, not that field's own well.
